assert.ok(evaluate(20, 0.1, "monthly") > 0)
assert.ok(usageQuote(30, 0.1, "monthly").amount > 0)
assert.ok(historySize() > 0)
assert.throws(() => evaluate(-1, 0.1, "monthly"), RangeError)
assert.ok(await subscriptionCharge(40) > 0)
assert.match(subscriptionLabel("account-a", 3.1), /^account-a:\d+ units$/)

usage:

evidence.reason: Left edit replaces metering.initialize() with metering.reset(), changes the plan argument from "monthly" to "benchmark", and returns metering.historySize() instead of a computed charge, altering the function's contract and likely breaking the test assertion subscriptionCharge(40) > 0.

Right edit adds only an early return for units === 0; for the tested positive units this is behavior-preserving and does not remove the RangeError for negative units, so it is not the primary source of risk.

subscriptionCharge depends on evaluate, which value-references usageCharge; the left edit's changed plan string and return value flow through this dependency path, so the merged behavior of the subscription path is not jointly guaranteed by the two edits.

The test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 and that evaluate(-1, ...) throws RangeError; the left edit's return of historySize() and plan change may violate the positive-charge expectation, while the right edit preserves the negative-units throw.

result.userExplanation: 左改动把订阅计费的初始化、计划参数和返回值都改了，可能让订阅计费测试失败，而右改动只是加了零值保护，风险主要来自左改动。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/subscription.ts 中 subscriptionCharge 的实现：恢复 metering.initialize() 和 "monthly" 计划参数，并返回基于 metering.evaluate 的计费结果，而不是 metering.historySize()；src/metering.ts 中 usageCharge 的零值保护可保留。
